learnings: Cloud Run revision tags enable instant traffic switching without redeploy
LIVE tag = 100% traffic, staging tag = 0% traffic (rollback is tag reassignment, <5 seconds)
Webhook listener needs elevated service account (run.admin + cloudbuild.builds.editor)
HMAC SHA-256 signature validation critical for webhook security
Health checks before traffic switch prevent deploying broken code
Standby service cost is negligible with min-instances=0 (scales to zero when idle)
